sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared/geographic-flat frames, including the north-up placement overlay. Six shared 256² sandstone, marble, continuous sandstone, standing-seam metal, cast bronze and wood graphs serve seven merged roles including opaque blue-grey glazing.
